manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); equal pair mean per tokenizer; headline = maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable), lo/hi = tokenizer span. Comparator: contronym-free complete-careful-English (mid tier). Terse tier (Take up/Skip X) and full tier (everything spelled) computed as declared diagnostics on identical pairs. CHALLENGE: both existing rows (055e4849 +2, 3d2798c0 -6.1) price the marker against bare table-glosses — the very contronym the proposal refuses — so neither measures marker-vs-meaning.
